summary: Device tiers follow privileged sign-ins, and only complete data is sent to your other systems.

fixes.title: Privileged sign-ins count for devices
fixes.text: A device that a Tier 0, 1 or 2 account signs in to takes that tier.

fixes.title: One tier problem no longer spoils a run
fixes.text: When one tier source fails, only that value shows as unknown on the devices, with the reason. The rest of the run is complete and goes on as usual.

fixes.title: Incomplete data is never sent out
fixes.text: Nothing built on incomplete source data is sent to ServiceNow or the workbooks. What they have stays, and the next complete run sends what changed.

fixes.title: Older program images are cleaned up safely
fixes.text: The clean-up of older program images no longer stops during long work. It records what it keeps before it deletes anything and reports its progress as it goes.

fixes.title: History keeps the newest 3 complete runs
fixes.text: Each installation now keeps the findings of its newest 3 complete runs instead of 7. Older runs keep their totals for the trends, and the log names each run removed.
